LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.AnomalyStagingDesc: When this is on, Anomaly events, weather, and store items unlock as the monolith wakes. Stirring opens the first tier. Waking opens the rest, including the golden cube. Unlocks stay after the monolith is disrupted. When this is off, anything enabled in the editor can be bought at any stage.
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.AnomalyBlockWhenDisabled: Block events when Anomaly is off

When this is on, and this save has Anomaly installed but Anomaly incidents turned off, chat cannot buy Anomaly events or weather. Store items such as the hellcat rifle stay on the store editor. When this is off, those events and weather can still be bought in a save that turned Anomaly incidents off.
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.EnableEventCooldownsDesc: Turn on/off all event cooldowns. When off, events can be purchased without limits.
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.LimitEventsByKarmaTypeDe: Set different limits for good, bad, and neutral events
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.EventCooldownDays: Event cooldown duration in game days:
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.ResetAllCooldowns: Reset all cooldown settings back to default values
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.EventCooldownDaysDesc: How many in-game days to count events. Affects: !event, !raid, !militaryaid, !weather
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.EventsPerCooldownDesc: Maximum events allowed in {0} days. 0 = unlimited
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.MaxBadEventsDesc: Bad events: !raid and other harmful events
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.MaxGoodEventsDesc: Good events: !militaryaid and other helpful events
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.MaxNeutralEventsDesc: Neutral events: !weather and other neutral events
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.MaxTraitsDesc: Maximum number of traits a single pawn can have
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.CooldownsDisabledMessage: Event cooldowns are disabled. All events can be purchased without limits.
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.ResetConfirmDesc:
Reset all cooldown settings to default values?

This will reset:
• Event cooldown days
• Event limits
• Karma type limits
• Purchase limits
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.LoadGameToAccessEditors: Load a game to access event editors and statistics
LanguageData.RICS.GameEvents.MainDescription: Configure cooldowns for events, traits, and store purchases. Manage all game interactions in one place.
